FROM orders_20210802_frame o
JOIN order_items_jaffles oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products_frame p ON oi.sku = p.sku
JOIN customers_frame c ON o.customer = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5
